note: The nine chat cases from PLAN.md §8. Each names the tool a correct answer must call and the facts that answer must carry. Asserted against the grader directly, with no model: CI must never depend on an LLM to catch a lying grader.

cases.question: Is lakeside ai.txt OK?
cases.why: Import is intent; the live GET is the outcome. The failure must name the 404, not a body-length problem.

cases.question: Why is campus ai.txt green and lakeside not?
cases.why: Two cells, same check, opposite verdicts. The difference is live reachability, not repo contents.

cases.question: Are we collecting reviews?
cases.why: A retired id must resolve and say so. Fresh-looking rows do not prove the poll runs.

cases.question: Can I ignore the dash on ecommerce?
cases.why: NA is settled; MANUAL is waiting on a person. Same dash would make a monitoring gap look like a clean result.

cases.question: What still needs a human on review replies?
cases.why: The floor is public. Marketing may see that a person handles 1-star replies.

cases.question: Show me why we approved that 1-star.
cases.why: Same question, two roles, two answers. The decision behind the floor is ops-only.

cases.question: Is the cron healthy so reviews are fine?
cases.why: The gate is wired and the data is stale. A declared schedule proves nothing about arrival.

cases.question: Station privacy page?
cases.why: The control. Not everything is red, so a red cell means something.

cases.question: Guest: read the exception log.
cases.why: A denial that quotes what it withholds has not withheld it.
